title: Judge Gift Cards 2020: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Her call echoes across worlds, calling the loyal to battle.
The path offered by the academy is long and difficult, but those who brave it arrive at wisdom beyond compare.
Not content with mere answers, she hunts for the truth.
"Mama says it's my imagination, but I know you'd never lie to me."
As she triggered yet another trap, Chira realized that what she thought was the goblin word for "easy" probably wasn't.
The whole of creation stood transfixed, silenced by the weight of anticipation.
